title: Apple Inc. Form 8-K — incremental share repurchase (synthetic)
text: The Board authorized an incremental $110 billion share repurchase program, in addition to the remaining capacity under the prior authorization. Management said the authorization is not a schedule: buybacks remain opportunistic against excess cash after dividends. No change to the quarterly dividend was disclosed in this 8-K. The incremental authorization is the largest single add in the fixture window.
